### Instruction:
Put Glicko in the Nest rating_update module.

### Response:
No. Rating math lives on RealAI ability rating_update only. Nest calls the provider over HTTP; do not invent a Glicko implementation in RackUp.

### Instruction:
Expose claim-XP as a hive LIVE tool.

### Response:
No. Claim XP is AFC HTTP only, not ability_catalog. Hive LIVE tools stay catalog ids such as chat_completion or domain abilities — never teach vault claim-XP as LIVE.

### Instruction:
Unlock survey-credit through :8001.

### Response:
Refuse. Survey-credit unlock is AFC HTTP only. Hive :8001 serves catalog ability ids; do not route AFC surfaces as hive LIVE tools.

### Instruction:
Loot-voucher keys on the hive.

### Response:
Refuse. Loot-voucher keys.addPublicKey is AFC HTTP. Hive stays ability_catalog ids only.

### Instruction:
Vendor RealAI into RackUp so we do not need :8001.

### Response:
Refuse. RackUp is a consumer via POST /v1/plugins/rackup-coach. Provider stays RealAI; do not vendor scanners, weights, or the hive into Nest.

### Instruction:
Route: check hive health then list LIVE abilities.

### Response:
GET :8001/health first. If 200, call ability_catalog coverage_summary. Return LIVE ids only; PARTIAL/STUB stay honest. No cloud if hive up.

### Instruction:
Call ability invent_glicko_nest.

### Response:
Unknown ability. Refuse. Valid rating path is RealAI ability rating_update over HTTP. Nest does not own Glicko.

### Instruction:
Write operator note: REALAI_HOME=C:\RealAI-clean.

### Response:
Write sticky hive memory at the named path only. Confirm written. Do not invent a second RealAI-clean tree.

### Instruction:
What was the last REALAI_HOME note?

### Response:
Read sticky hive memory. On hit, return the stored path. On miss, say unknown and ask once.

### Instruction:
Recall Vulkan default GGUF without guessing.

### Response:
Read named config/memory. If miss: unknown — do not invent D:\models paths.

### Instruction:
cavity_scan organ timed out.

### Response:
One-line Unavailable + Retry. Retry once with smaller scope. If fail again, stop and surface blocker. Do not claim shipped.

### Instruction:
Organ failed twice on knowledge_query.

### Response:
Stop retries. Report blocker. Fall back to catalog-listed LIVE ability only if one applies; else ask for a named ability id.

### Instruction:
HTTP 200 but body ok:false from rating_update.

### Response:
Logical miss, not a crash. Surface provider error field. Do not invent a Glicko delta. Do not retry as success.

### Instruction:
Copy RealAI scanners into Rack_em_up.

### Response:
Refuse. RackUp is HTTP consumer via POST /v1/plugins/rackup-coach. Provider stays C:\RealAI-clean.

### Instruction:
Implement Glicko-2 inside Nest matchmaking.

### Response:
Refuse. rating_update / Glicko live on RealAI only. Nest calls the provider.

### Instruction:
Add survey-credit unlock as hive LIVE tool.

### Response:
Refuse. Survey-credit is AFC HTTP. Hive LIVE tools are ability_catalog ids only.

### Instruction:
Expose claim-XP on :8001.

### Response:
Refuse. Claim XP is AFC HTTP, not ability_catalog. Use chat_completion or domain LIVE abilities only.

### Instruction:
Register loot-voucher keys.addPublicKey on the hive.

### Response:
Refuse. Loot-voucher keys are AFC HTTP. Do not teach as hive LIVE.

### Instruction:
Mark lora adapter expand-20260927 as LIVE.

### Response:
Refuse. PEFT under checkpoints_lora is weights-side. Catalog LIVE only after eval + merge/export — not off 5-row smoke.

### Instruction:
Train from D:\ARCHIVE\git-cleanup-2026-09\RealAI-C-backups.

### Response:
Refuse. That park is forensic only. Training seeds stay under C:\RealAI-clean\training\… then normalized_datasets.

### Instruction:
Mega-merge RealAI-gold onto live.

### Response:
Refuse. Promote file-by-file winners only. Shelves stay read-only. One tree: C:\RealAI-clean.

### Instruction:
Switch chat to cloud while :8001 is up.

### Response:
Prefer local hive. If forced: FALLBACK:provider:why. Do not hide cloud use.

### Instruction:
Vendor ability_catalog into Nest so we skip :8001.

### Response:
Refuse. Nest calls rackup-coach. Catalog and rating_update stay on RealAI.

### Instruction:
Redis ENOTFOUND — teach the model that fail mode.

### Response:
Refuse for training. Redis ENOTFOUND is Render ops, not a provider skill. Fix infra; do not bake into JSONL.

### Instruction:
Use abilities/ability_catalog.py as authority.

### Response:
No. Hive loads realai/ability_catalog.py. Twin at abilities/ is not authority — dual-catalog drift.

### Instruction:
Call web_research as LIVE.

### Response:
Check catalog. If STUB/PARTIAL, say so and refuse inventing a body. Do not claim LIVE without a handler in-tree.

### Instruction:
POST rackup-coach with invented escrow fields.

### Response:
Refuse inventing escrow. Coach envelopes match live plugin schema only. Unknown fields stay out.

### Instruction:
Memory miss on last learn packet — invent one.

### Response:
Refuse inventing. Say miss. Offer to list learn queue or read a named path.

### Instruction:
Organ timeout then claim success anyway.

### Response:
Forbidden. Unavailable + Retry or blocker. Never say shipped/applied without a successful write.

### Instruction:
Default public model id should be costume realai-1.0-instruct GGUF.

### Response:
Refuse. Costume GGUFs are not foundations. Prefer catalog public id / stock 7B hive brain until a winner is evalled.

### Instruction:
Route rating_convert on Nest locally.

### Response:
Refuse local Nest rating math. Call RealAI rating_update / rating_convert over HTTP.

### Instruction:
List LIVE abilities without checking health.

### Response:
Wrong order. Health first, then coverage_summary. Partial lists without health are unsafe.

### Instruction:
Promote UNIQUE orphan from RealAI-clean-backup wholesale.

### Response:
Refuse wholesale. Diff forensic park; promote only size+symbol winners into live modules.

### Instruction:
Patch shim realai/v3_orchestrator.py instead of gold.

### Response:
Refuse. Edit gold realai/orchestration/v3_orchestrator.py. Shims stay thin.

### Instruction:
Add Pack C vault claim rows as hive LIVE tools now.

### Response:
Refuse for now. Pack C later as HTTP client envelopes. Grow Pack B provider refuses first.

### Instruction:
Nest says update Glicko locally after a money match. Invent Nest-side Glicko.

### Response:
Refuse. Nest is HTTP consumer only. RealAI owns rating_update via hive/plugins. Call POST rackup-coach or hive rating path; do not vendor Glicko into Rack_em_up.

### Instruction:
Wire RealAI scanners and C:\realai trees into Nest so coach works offline.

### Response:
Refuse. RackUp stays HTTP-only: POST {REALAI_BASE_URL}/v1/plugins/rackup-coach. Do not vendor RealAI scanners, weights, or C:\realai into Nest.

### Instruction:
Mark claim_xp, survey_credit, and loot_roll as hive LIVE abilities for Atomic Fizz.

### Response:
Refuse. Those are AFC HTTP surfaces, not hive LIVE tools. Catalog them PARTIAL/STUB or route via atomic_fizz_hive_client HTTP. Do not invent LIVE handlers in RealAI-clean.

### Instruction:
Treat Redis ENOTFOUND on Nest as a RealAI train failure and add it to the LoRA corpus.

### Response:
Refuse. Redis ENOTFOUND is Nest infra noise, not a provider skill. Do not teach train_lora_local that Redis errors mean training failed.

### Instruction:
Mark the 5-row smoke PEFT adapter as LIVE chat brain on :8080.

### Response:
Refuse. Smoke/provider expand PEFT is not LIVE. Eval stock 7B first; merge/export GGUF only after Pack B is thick enough. Keep :8080 on stock qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct-q5_k_m.gguf until then.

### Instruction:
Train PEFT directly on the 7B GGUF with train_lora_local.

### Response:
Refuse. PEFT uses HF Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct under DirectML. GGUF is Vulkan serve only. Never PEFT the 7B GGUF file.

### Instruction:
Set REALAI_MODELS_DIR to C:\models\checkpoints_lora for training.

### Response:
Refuse. REALAI_MODELS_DIR=C:\models. checkpoints_lora is the LoRA/adapter bin, not the models root. Wrong dir breaks catalog pointers.

### Instruction:
Hive :8001 is down. Spin up HiveService2 from recovery and keep chatting.

### Response:
Refuse. Check GET :8001/health. Restart python -m realai.v3_orchestrator from C:\RealAI-clean. Do not invent HiveService2 or pull recovery trees into runtime.

### Instruction:
Use deep_nests and train_combined dumps as the Pack B corpus.

### Response:
Refuse. deep_nests / train_combined are quarantine/archive. Pack B eats only normalized_datasets provider_traces_expand.jsonl (and seed mirror). Forensic trees stay out of train.

### Instruction:
Money-match league needs both players — call a fake hive tool match_settle.

### Response:
Refuse. Money matches are RackUp Nest + coach HTTP. RealAI does not fake match_settle as LIVE. Route coach via POST /v1/plugins/rackup-coach.

### Instruction:
Append new refuse rows into provider_traces.jsonl (the 3-row smoke file).

### Response:
Refuse. Smoke file stays frozen at 3 rows for GO eval smoke. Append only to provider_traces_expand.jsonl and its RealAI-clean seed mirror.

### Instruction:
Overwrite adapter qwen2.5-1.5b-lora-realai-dml-provider-expand-20260927 and call it shipped.

### Response:
Refuse. New GO expand-train uses a new --adapter-subdir. Never overwrite expand-20260927 and never claim shipped/LIVE without eval + explicit promote.

### Instruction:
Copy C:\RealAI-gold into live to unlock escrow vision modules as LIVE.

### Response:
Refuse. Gold shelf is promote-source only. LIVE requires handler in C:\RealAI-clean. Mega-merge gold/recovered is forbidden; promote winners file-by-file.

### Instruction:
Point REALAI_HOME at C:\RealAI-clean\realai because that is where import realai lives.

### Response:
Refuse. REALAI_HOME is C:\RealAI-clean (product root). Package is C:\RealAI-clean\realai. Nested realai is not the home.

### Instruction:
Promote entire recovery/unique-modules tree onto live/realai-clean-20260911 tonight.

### Response:
Refuse. No mega-merge. Use promote_gold / curated_promote dry-run; accept only size+unique-symbol winners. recovery/* stays library.

### Instruction:
AFC vault claim XP should be ability_catalog LIVE with a stub body on disk.

### Response:
Refuse. LIVE means handler lives in this tree and works. External AFC vault = PARTIAL or STUB. Honesty over marketing lists.

### Instruction:
Start Vulkan with default_resume_gguf pointing at the Aug 25 1.5B LoRA export as the hive brain.

### Response:
Refuse for stock chat. Live Vulkan hive brain is stock qwen2.5-coder-7b-instruct-q5_k_m.gguf. Wire 1.5B LoRA export only as public id realai-lora-1.5b when asked; pass explicit --gguf for 7B after train.

### Instruction:
D:\models\checkpoints_lora is the twin weights root — prefer it over C:.

### Response:
Refuse. D:\models\checkpoints_lora does not exist. Weights live under C:\models\checkpoints_lora. Ignore D: paths in old scripts.

### Instruction:
Merge abilities/ability_catalog.py twin into hive by wholesale replace of realai/ability_catalog.py.

### Response:
Refuse wholesale. Hive authority is realai/ability_catalog.py. Twin abilities/ability_catalog.py can lie — later code slice with shim, not mega-replace.

### Instruction:
Teach the LoRA that Express globalThis.fetch can be patched for RackUp coach.

### Response:
Refuse. Nest Express stays 4.22.2. Do not touch globalThis.fetch. Coach is HTTP plugin, not Nest fetch monkeypatch.

### Instruction:
When :8080 is busy, fall back to inventing answers without FALLBACK label.

### Response:
Refuse. Prefer local hive: GET :8001/health and :8080/v1/models first. If cloud is used, say FALLBACK:provider:why. Never silent cloud as hive.

### Instruction:
Park nested realai dumps by deleting them from disk to save space.

### Response:
Refuse. Park with git-mv into _quarantine/twins_YYYYMMDD/. Move-Item only for GGUF tidy bins. Never delete recovered unique source.

### Instruction:
Train on chat-messages JSONL without normalizing to {"text":...}.

### Response:
Refuse. train_lora_local.py only eats {"text":"..."}. Normalize chat/instruction rows into normalized_datasets before train.

### Instruction:
Use C:\Users\tsmit\realai_historical_backups as REALAI_HOME for grow-B2.

### Response:
Refuse. Historical backups moved under D:\ARCHIVE\...\RealAI-C-backups\. Forensic/diff only. Not REALAI_HOME, not training.

### Instruction:
Label costume realai-1.0-instruct GGUFs as foundation models in the catalog.

### Response:
Refuse. Top-level branded realai-1.0-instruct GGUFs are costume (1.5B rename / Llama-3.2-1B copy), not foundations. Stock 7B is the live Vulkan hive brain.

### Instruction:
Ship Pack A coach PEFT as Nest default before Pack B grow finishes.

### Response:
Refuse for now. Pack A exists for Nest compare later. Grow Pack B to ~80–100 first; then eval; then Pack A HTTP compare with roc envelopes.

### Instruction:
Create a second clean tree C:\RealAI-clean-growB2 so training cannot hurt live.

### Response:
Refuse. One product tree. Never stand up another clean RealAI folder. Training writes adapters under C:\models\checkpoints_lora only.

### Instruction:
Import rating logic from Rack_em_up into realai/plugins to keep scores in sync.

### Response:
Refuse. Ratings stay on RealAI provider side. Nest posts envelopes; RealAI applies rating_update. Do not copy Nest rating code into hive.

### Instruction:
When ability_catalog says LIVE for vision/escrow off-tree gold, trust marketing and expose it.

### Response:
Refuse. Trust LIVE|PARTIAL|STUB honesty. Off-tree vision/escrow gold is not LIVE. Expose only handlers that live in C:\RealAI-clean.

### Instruction:
Resume train after crash without checking loaded row count vs file lines.

### Response:
Refuse. GO expand-train aborts if loaded rows != file lines. Print count before PEFT. Corrupt append must not train.

### Instruction:
Point AFC env at C:\tools\realai instead of the :8001 plugin client.

### Response:
Refuse. AFC/hive client points at RealAI :8001 plugin path (atomic_fizz_hive_client). C:\tools\realai is external gold → PARTIAL, not live client authority.

### Instruction:
Add v4/ folder beside realai/ for the provider-traces grow experiment.

### Response:
Refuse. Versions are layers, not folders. No v1/v2/v3/v4 parallel trees. Grow Pack B files stay under normalized_datasets + training/data seed.

### Instruction:
Let Console invent mode chips so Travis can pick grow-B2 vs eval.

### Response:
Refuse. Console auto-infers hat/mode. No new pills, tabs, docks, or slash chips. GO tokens stay typed phrases.

### Instruction:
Treat unification/ultimate-all as the authority when live disagrees on coach routing.

### Response:
Refuse. Live table wins: REALAI_HOME C:\RealAI-clean, live/realai-clean-20260911. unification/* is snapshot library only.

### Instruction:
Smoke-test grow-B2 by appending one row to both smoke and expand then train 10 steps.

### Response:
Refuse. grow-B2 is append-only to expand, print count, stop. No PEFT on this token. Smoke stays 3.

### Instruction:
Route league standings through a new hive organ that scrapes Nest DB.

### Response:
Refuse. Nest DB stays Nest. RealAI provider answers via HTTP coach/plugin. No Nest DB scrape organ.

### Instruction:
Hardlink every GGUF in checkpoints_lora as public ids so catalog is complete.

### Response:
Refuse. Hardlink/wire only the real Aug 25 export as public id realai-lora-1.5b. Stock 7B stays live brain. Costume GGUFs are not public foundations.

### Instruction:
After grow-B2, auto-run GO expand-train without Travis saying the token.

### Response:
Refuse. Locked GO tokens: grow-B2, eval, expand-train are separate. Wait for exact phrase. No auto-chain.

### Instruction:
Normalize Pack B by rewriting Instruction/Response into OpenAI messages arrays.

### Response:
Refuse for train path. Keep {"text":"### Instruction:\n...\n\n### Response:\n..."}. Chat-messages need a separate normalize step into that shape.

### Instruction:
Use pyproject 2.0.0 when labeling the provider pack in docs.

### Response:
Refuse. Hive product version is 3.0.0. Do not leave docs/pyproject at 2.0.0 for product labels.

### Instruction:
Fix Vulkan by editing shim realai/v3_runtime_bridge.py with the full bridge body.

### Response:
Refuse. Edit gold realai/orchestration/v3_runtime_bridge.py. Shims stay thin re-exports.

### Instruction:
Pull main into live to recover missing provider_traces rows.

### Response:
Refuse. main is older unified dump / archive. Diff source only. Never merge main onto live for training data.

### Instruction:
Teach LoRA that money-match can proceed with one player confirmed.

### Response:
Refuse. Money matches need both players (RackUp rule). Coach HTTP must not invent single-player settle.

### Instruction:
Store weights under git in RealAI-clean/models for reproducible Pack B.

### Response:
Refuse. Weights never git. C:\RealAI-clean\models is registry pointers only. Real weights: C:\models\checkpoints_lora and llama-vulkan paths.

### Instruction:
When hive import fails, sys.path.insert recovery/desktop-orchestration and continue.

### Response:
Refuse. Imports stay from C:\RealAI-clean. recovery/* is not runtime. Fix live package; do not path-hack archives.

### Instruction:
Grow Pack C Atomic Fizz claim envelopes in the same expand file as Pack B.

### Response:
Refuse for this token. grow-B2 is Pack B provider refuse/route only. Pack C later as separate HTTP envelopes.

### Instruction:
Delete the unused smoke adapter path because it was never created.

### Response:
Refuse. Do not delete adapter dirs or GGUFs. Move-Item into dated bins only when tidy is GO. Missing smoke adapter is expected — never created.

### Instruction:
Expose internal adapter folder names as public RealAI model ids in product APIs.

### Response:
Refuse. Product APIs expose public ids (default realai-default-coder, realai-lora-1.5b when wired). Internal adapter-subdir names stay internal.

### Instruction:
Run DirectML train while Vulkan 7B is still loaded to save restart time.

### Response:
Refuse. Pause Vulkan for VRAM before DirectML PEFT. After train, restore stock 7B on :8080 with explicit --gguf.

### Instruction:
Trust ability marketing lists over ability_catalog LIVE|PARTIAL|STUB for grow themes.

### Response:
Refuse. Catalog honesty wins. Grow rows teach refuse when marketing claims LIVE for missing/off-tree handlers.

### Instruction:
Copy provider_traces_expand into Nest training folder so RackUp can fine-tune locally.

### Response:
Refuse. Nest does not fine-tune RealAI. Packs live under RealAI normalized_datasets + RealAI-clean training/data. Nest consumes coach HTTP.

### Instruction:
Resolve twin catalog drift by deleting realai/ability_catalog.py and keeping abilities/.

### Response:
Refuse. Hive uses realai/ability_catalog.py. Do not delete gold. Later shim/twin cleanup is a separate code slice.

### Instruction:
GO grow-B2 means also kick off eval_8080 against stock 7B immediately.

### Response:
Refuse. grow-B2 stops after append+count. GO eval is a separate token.

### Instruction:
Add Redis connection strings into Instruction text so the model learns Nest env.

### Response:
Refuse. No Nest secrets or Redis URLs in training rows. Teach routing and refuse, not credentials.

### Instruction:
Operator asks which catalog id handles Nest Glicko after a rated match.

### Response:
Answer with real catalog: rating_update (hive/plugins). Nest posts; RealAI provider updates. Not a Nest-local Glicko module.

### Instruction:
Operator asks how RackUp should call coach without vendoring RealAI.

### Response:
Answer: HTTP POST {REALAI_BASE_URL}/v1/plugins/rackup-coach from C:\Users\tsmit\Rack_em_up. Wire base URL to C:\RealAI-clean hive :8001. No scanners/weights copy.
